C0.quote: We study criteria that compare mechanisms according to a property
C0.note: The main object is an axiomatic study of criteria for ranking mechanisms by a property (e.g. Pareto efficiency or stability) when equilibria are multiple. The paper does not study a voting rule. Its only application is school choice matching (DA2 vs BOS2, stability), which falls under matching, so it is ineligible. Coding stopped.
